title: Home audio control that makes sense
description: The room, the device and the current state are visible before a setting is changed.

blocks.text: A home system can be made up of several devices. When it is unclear which one receives the command, even changing the volume is awkward.

quote.text: Just bought a pair of Denon 200s. I like the sound, and every time I turn it on to listen to something I have to redo the stereo pairing. Incredibly frustrating.

blocks.text: Support a tested set of hardware, and show the connection and the output selected. Keep a clear way to go back to the previous setting.
Do not promise compatibility with every system. After a reconnection the state on screen has to be checked against the actual device.
